scientific_question: Does adding the missing fast residual chart specifically to pair-VQ c_proj raise its sigma-delta conservation to the already-repaired c_fc regime without giving up compact state or acceptable MFU?

causal_basis.observation: At step 152, c_fc conserved 0.9746 of request energy while c_proj conserved only 0.6617. The implementation difference is exact: c_fc has two slow stages plus a fast residual, while c_proj has one slow stage and no fast residual.
causal_basis.mechanism: The carry is stable and compact, but c_proj repeatedly rejects a coherent normal component. A side-local fast chart creates cell-scale motion in the deficient weight representation before the carry is quantized again.
